sloka: ततः परिषदं सर्वामामन्त्र्य वसुधाधिपः ।हितमुद्धर्षणं चैवमुवाच प्रथितं वचः ॥२-२-१॥
transliteration: tataḥ pariṣadaṁ sarvāmāmantrya vasudhādhipaḥ ।hitamuddharṣaṇaṁ caivamuvāca prathitaṁ vacaḥ ॥2-2-1॥

translations.english: Thereafter, the lord of the earth (king Dasaratha) addressed the entire assembly of invitees. He spoke these pleasing words aimed at their welfare which thrilled and delighted the hearts (of the assembled kings):
translations.hindi: उधर महाराज दशरथ राम से यह कह कि, कल तुम युवराज दु पर अभिषिक्त किए जाओगे, पुरोहित वसिष्ठ जी को बुला, उनसे बोले
